title: Separation under a distance condition
statement:
Let $s,t,\delta$ be real numbers such that $s^2=1$, $0\leq\delta\leq 1/1600$, and $1521\delta<(t^2-1)^2$. Then
\[
169\delta\leq(s-t)^2.
\]
